senses.gloss:
--born of सविता: ग्राम्य and आरण्य; killing of except in यज्ञस् considered as हिम्सा; sacrifice of, for preta, भूत, and गणस् irreligious and sinful;
1: भा. VI. १८. 1; VII. १५. 7-१०; XI. १०. २८; २१. २९-30; Vi. I. 5. ५१-2.
the sages finding many heads of cattle for sacrificial purposes by Indra com- plained about the हिम्सा and said that हिम्सा must be remov- ed from the sacrifices and that they could be performed only with seeds and corns; there was a difference of opinion and the sages referred the question to king Vasu; he called it हिम्सा and was punished; final conclusion that in killing पशु in a यज्ञ there was no हिम्सा;
2: वा. ५७. ९२-114.
fourteen kinds dis- tinguished.
3: Br. IV. 6. ५४; II. ३२. ११-2, १६.
[page२-306+ २८]
--attacked by Rudra. वा. ८८. १३५.

(I)--fourth name of शिव; the fifth तनु of Agni; has पचिकशक्ति; wife स्वाहा and son Skanda;
1: Br. II. १०. ८०; वा. २७. ११, ५३; ३०. ८९.
hence fire to be kept clean.
2: Br. II. १०. १३ and ४५.

(II)--see Rudra;
1: M. १५४. ४८५. Vi. I. 8. 6; V. १८. ५६.
the presiding deity of fire.
2: M. १६२. 9; २६५. ४०.
--a name of कार्तवीर्य. M. ४३. २७; वा. ९४. २४.

--Vedic sacrifices;
1: M. २४६. ६४.
in the chest of the personified Veda.
2: वा. १०४. ८३.
--sacrifice incumbent on house-holders. Br. IV. 6. ७३.
--a sacrifice performed by Bharata. भा. V. 7. 5.
--in यज्ञ condemned by sages but justified by Indra. Br. II. ३०. १७-18.

--प्रजापति after creating the eight deva- yonis with four kinds of serpents and of spirits, proceeded to create birds and beasts; sheep from face, crows from breast, cows from belly, and sides; from feet, horses, elephants, शरभ, gavaya deer, camel, etc., from hairs, vegetables, fruits and roots. वा. 9. ४१-5.
--a R. from the पारियात्र. Br. II. १६. २८. [page२-324+ ३६]
--a R. from शुक्तिमन्त. M. ११४. ३२.
(II)--a तीर्थ on the पार्वतीका, sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ५६.

--the earliest form of yoga established; even Gods like Indra practised this and got wealth consti- tuting अणिमा, महिमा, लघिमा, प्राप्ति, गरिमा, प्राकानुजम्, ईशित्वम्, वाशित्वम्, and अमरत्वम्;
1: Br. II. २७. ११६, १२८; वा. 1. १९५.
one who practises it at Benares is rid of the cycle of births and deaths.
2: M. १८२. १२.
--ordained for all आश्रमस्. वा. ३०. २९५.
--followers of the पाशुपत yogam. Br. III. ३२. 5.

--cattle raising and tending not in पुष्क- द्वीप;
1: Br. II. १९. १२१; वा. ४९. ११७.
duty of the वैश्यस्.
2: Br. II. 7. १६२; Vi. III. 8. ३०.
